selected_evidence.summary: Service is active and enabled; heartbeat records demonstrate continuous operation and restart recovery.
Runtime namespace probes succeeded under `/var/lib/inventory` and failed under `/etc`, `/tmp`, `/var/tmp`, `/dev/shm`, sibling `/var/lib`, `/run`, and `/home`, both before and after reboot.
Live process evidence reports `NoNewPrivs: 1` with inheritable, permitted, effective, bounding, and ambient capability sets all zero.

Healthy baseline used boot ID `e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7`; reboot was acknowledged; execution returned with changed boot ID `d9f73744-9441-42b9-9903-78b11bc7744a`; the service, persistent data, privilege restrictions, and write confinement recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker <<'ANTRIEB_WORKER'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 027
log=/var/lib/inventory/worker.log
printf '%s started pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$$" >> "$log"
trap 'printf "%s stopped pid=%s\\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$$" >> "$log"; exit 0' TERM INT
while :; do
  printf '%s heartbeat pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$$" >> "$log"
  sleep 15 &
  wait "$!"
done
ANTRIEB_WORKER
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
DynamicUser=yes
StateDirectory=inventory
StateDirectoryMode=0750
UMask=0027
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateTmp=no
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

set -eu
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID -p User -p DynamicUser -p StateDirectory -p NoNewPrivileges -p ProtectSystem -p ProtectHome -p ReadWritePaths -p CapabilityBoundingSet -p Restart
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
printf '%s\n' '--- process security state ---'
awk '/^(Name|Pid|Uid|Gid|NoNewPrivs|CapInh|CapPrm|CapEff|CapBnd|CapAmb):/' "/proc/$pid/status"
printf '%s\n' '--- inventory data ---'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' /var/lib/inventory /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
tail -n 5 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log

commands.command:
set -u
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
uid=$(stat -Lc %u /var/lib/inventory/worker.log)
gid=$(stat -Lc %g /var/lib/inventory/worker.log)
printf 'pid=%s uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$pid" "$uid" "$gid"
run_in_sandbox() { nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- setpriv --reuid="$uid" --regid="$gid" --clear-groups sh -c "$1"; }
run_in_sandbox "printf 'sandbox write ok\\n' >> /var/lib/inventory/confinement-probe"
printf 'allowed_path_rc=%s\n' "$?"
run_in_sandbox ": > /etc/inventory-worker-escape" 2>&1
printf 'etc_escape_rc=%s\n' "$?"
run_in_sandbox ": > /tmp/inventory-worker-escape" 2>&1
printf 'tmp_escape_rc=%s\n' "$?"
printf 'allowed_path_content='; tail -n 1 /var/lib/inventory/confinement-probe
if [ -e /etc/inventory-worker-escape ] || [ -e /tmp/inventory-worker-escape ]; then printf 'escape_artifact=present\n'; exit 1; else printf 'escape_artifact=absent\n'; fi
